name: Lightning Rod
specialElements: 45-mph launch up the lift hill instead of a chain; 73° drop; quadruple-down airtime run; converted from wood to RMC Ibox hybrid track in 2021
records: World's first launched wooden coaster; fastest wooden coaster on Earth (73 mph) when it opened in 2016

name: Wild Eagle
specialElements: Riders sit on wings beside the track with nothing above or below; loop, zero-g roll, Immelmann, and corkscrew; perched on a ridge 21 stories over the park
records: First B&M wing coaster in the United States

name: Thunderhead
specialElements: Fly-through station; 22 track crossovers packed into a mountain hollow; Millennium Flyer trains
records: Golden Ticket Award winner for Best Wooden Coaster (2005)

name: Mystery Mine
specialElements: Beyond-vertical 95° drop out of a haunted coal mine; indoor dark-ride sections with fire effects; retracked in 2023 with a smoother inversion finale
records: One of the first Euro-Fighter coasters in the US

name: Tennessee Tornado
specialElements: Dives through a 110-ft mountain tunnel into an iconic butterfly loop; carved into Smoky Mountain terrain
records: Arrow Dynamics' last major custom looping coaster

name: FireChaser Express
specialElements: Launches forward at the start and backward out of a fireworks finale scene; firefighter theme

name: Blazing Fury
specialElements: Indoor dark-ride coaster through a burning 1880s town — "Fire in the hole!"; surprise drops in the dark; built when the park was still Silver Dollar City

name: Dragonflier
specialElements: Suspended coaster that swoops like a dragonfly over Wildwood Grove; feet dangle above the treetops

name: Whistle Punk Chaser
specialElements: Junior coaster themed to logging-camp "whistle punks"; 36-inch height requirement makes it a first coaster for many kids

name: Big Bear Mountain
specialElements: Three launches on an expedition to find the legendary Big Bear; onboard audio; headlight-equipped SUV trains; mist tunnel behind a waterfall
records: Longest coaster at Dollywood (3,990 ft); largest ride investment in park history at opening ($25M)

name: NightFlight Expedition
specialElements: World-first hybrid of indoor coaster and whitewater raft ride; amphibious vehicles fly over the Smokies at night, then splash through 500,000 gallons of rushing water; opened August 19, 2026
records: First-of-its-kind attraction — at $50M+, the largest in Dollywood history
